provider.organization_type: global protected-area, OECM, boundary, designation, governance, management-category, country-profile, indicator, API, geospatial-download, and reporting infrastructure
provider.description: The World Database on Protected Areas is the global authoritative compilation of protected-area records and boundaries maintained through Protected Planet by UNEP-WCMC in collaboration with IUCN and national, regional, and international data providers. Protected Planet also publishes the World Database on Other Effective Area-based Conservation Measures, country and regional profiles, global statistics, reports, APIs, and geospatial downloads.
institutional_context: International Union for Conservation of Nature
IUCN World Commission on Protected Areas
National governments, territories, convention secretariats, regional bodies, indigenous peoples, local communities, NGOs, and other data providers

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting WDPA and Protected Planet documentation, organization, protected areas, OECMs, identifiers, names, legal status, designations, IUCN categories, governance, management authority, geometry, areas, country and regional profiles, APIs, downloads, schemas, manuals, quality-control workflows, reports, licenses, citations, software, standards, and related authorities.
purpose.authoritative_notice: Protected Planet, UNEP-WCMC, official WDPA and WD-OECM releases, national and other submitting authorities, official legal instruments, CBD and IUCN standards, official geospatial and country-code authorities, and cited sources remain authoritative for site status, boundaries, identifiers, versions, rights, and contacts.
